component.name: foSSH Console
component.summary: Administer a self-hosted, privacy-preserving analytics install

description.p: foSSH Console is the local administration interface for a foSSH install. It shows what your sites recorded today, runs real queries against the rollup store, manages external services you have added, and drives first-run operator enrollment.

foSSH itself is self-hosted site analytics that does not trade your visitors' privacy for your dashboard. There is no cross-site identity, no cookies, no device fingerprinting, no raw IP addresses at rest, and no third-party egress from the ingest path. Reported groups are k-anonymised before they reach any read path, so a breakdown cannot single out an individual visitor.
The console talks to a local helper process over a pipe. It never listens on a socket, and it holds no credential longer than the call that carries it.
First release of the console. Replaces the terminal interface shipped through 0.1.3, which is retired along with the rest of that line.
